info.text:
We're managing social media free for 3 Gainesville businesses. 3 months. 3 spots.

We're adding social media management to what we do, and we want to start close to home. For 3 months, we run Facebook and Instagram for 3 businesses in Gainesville and Alachua County:

- 3 posts a week (2 reels or carousels, plus 1 tip or carousel)
- A monthly content plan you approve before anything is made
- A short monthly results report: reach, engagement, and clicks to your site
- Captions, music and scheduling, handled

What we ask: approve each month's plan within 2 business days, add us as a manager in Meta, send real photos or footage when we ask, let us share the results as a case study (and a short review if you are happy), and give us an honest check-in at the end of month 3.

After that, it is $600 a month, month to month, and pilot businesses keep that rate for as long as they stay. No auto-billing, no contract, cancel any time. No ad spend is included and we do not promise follower or sales numbers.

To claim a spot, call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message K&A Performance. Alex picks the 3 best fits.
